rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides read-only access to Google Search Console properties through service account authentication. Supports querying search analytics data across multiple dimensions including clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position, with filtering by page, query, country, device, and date range. Includes URL inspection for indexing status and crawl information, plus sitemap listing to verify submission status and indexed URL counts.
